Lay's Potato Chips Storyboard Vertical 

First Shot (0–2.5 sec) Anticipation Build-up
The camera focuses tightly on a Lay's chip bag's sealed top. The background is blurred, drawing attention to the vibrant colors and logo. A hand swiftly enters the frame and tears the bag open.
Visual Focus: The package's vibrant color and the sense of eagerly opening it.
Sound Effect (SFX): A loud, crisp "riiiip" of the bag tearing.
Voiceover (VO - Light, Energetic): "The crunch count is on. Initiating joy."

Second Shot (2.5–5 sec) Golden Ascent
Slow-motion close-up shot: several golden, perfectly ridged chips fly out of the bag opening and tumble in the air. The chips' texture, oil sheen, and subtle seasoning are clearly visible.
Visual Focus: The appealing texture and color of the chips.
SFX: Subtly amplified, appealing "shhh" sound of chips rustling.

Third Shot (5–7.5 sec) The Perfect Bite
A hand rapidly grabs a chip and brings it up to the mouth. The shot tightens to an extreme close-up of the chip entering the mouth, followed by a loud, magnified, satisfying "CRUNCH" sound. The person's face instantly registers satisfaction and enjoyment.
Visual Focus: Emphasizing the crispness and the immediate sensory reward.
VO: "Crisp perfection. Zero to happy in one second."

Fourth Shot (7.5–10 sec) Joy Fulfilled
The bag of chips is aggressively positioned and slightly tilted in the center frame (vertical), with a few loose chips scattered around it. The lighting is bright and inviting. A short, catchy English tagline appears at the bottom.
Visual Focus: The final product hero shot and the cheerful atmosphere.
On-Screen Text: "Lay's. Good vibes in every bite."
VO: "The flavor you can't stop. That's Lay's."
